items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Preserve $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed for 2026-09-21; do not infer site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or budget capacity. Continue period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation only.

Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align; AI-cost records conflict ($881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls); infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and learning-outcome records are absent or incomplete. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation. Retain the three SEO/performance opportunities as deferred backlog; do not treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, performance scores, ordered items, or AI usage as financial returns.
